directive: **Deployment** — ONE stage, two parts. (1) **Link** the repositories this project spans: emit `<repo_link owner/repo>` for each (clones into the hub + records the link in plan.db; `bsc-plan repo add owner/repo`, `bsc-plan repo list`). (2) **Ship**: define how each service DEPLOYS, recorded in plan.db — `bsc-plan deploy set` (config JSON: `services`, ONE per repo — each a self-contained deployable unit carrying its OWN `platform`+`workload`, ≥2 `environments`, a staged `pipeline`, `secrets`, and a `release.strategy`). The gate needs BOTH: ≥1 repo linked AND every repo's service deploy-ready. `bsc-plan deploy get` shows the stored config. (Dependencies are locked in the **Streams** stage now, #1429 — not here.)
name: Deployment
blurb: Link the repos and define how each service deploys.
